north_star: Turn fresh market and portfolio evidence into one understandable daily decision, then prove whether that decision helped.
current_milestone: Turn the architecture into an interactive model map while completing the paper-outcome learning loop.

deployment.name: Mobile navigation and responsive layout
deployment.detail: Five primary destinations replace the original long page list and were tested at a 390px viewport.

deployment.name: Architecture and activity pages
deployment.detail: Both pages are part of the production Streamlit app and their source data is committed.

deployment.name: Latest code on GitHub main
deployment.detail: The application code and dashboard database are available from the main branch.

deployment.name: Create permanent Streamlit Community Cloud app
deployment.detail: The permanent app is deployed from Rnanda442/stockprediction2025, branch main, with dashboard/app.py as the entry point.

deployment.name: Configure Streamlit dashboard secret
deployment.detail: The deployed app shows its private password gate, confirming DASHBOARD_PASSWORD is configured without being committed.

deployment.name: Verify cloud data and phone login
deployment.detail: Confirm dashboard_data.db loads, the password gate works, and Today, Activity, and Architecture work on a phone.

deployment.name: Record the permanent app URL
deployment.detail: The verified Streamlit URL is recorded in the README and GitHub repository homepage.

goals.name: Understand today's decision
goals.evidence: Today now prioritizes decision reasons, risk, recent return evidence, model drivers, and portfolio context; Architecture includes a 3D system map with implementation status.

goals.name: Respect account and portfolio limits
goals.evidence: Constraint snapshot and warnings exist; buying power and row-level blocking still need work.

goals.name: Prove decisions with paper outcomes
goals.evidence: Automatic daily decisions are recorded; future 1d, 5d, 20d, and 60d outcomes still need to be attached.

goals.name: Backtest the complete policy
goals.evidence: Portfolio Replay exists, but it does not yet replay the full daily decision policy.

goals.name: Improve models only when they win
goals.evidence: Time-split logistic baselines exist for 5d, 20d, and 60d horizons.

completed: Create a Daily Decision Board with hold as a valid action.
Restore and expose model exports for 5d, 20d, and 60d horizons.
Add a project charter and system architecture.
Add a readable variable decoder and architecture view.
Simplify the dashboard into mobile-friendly navigation groups.
Define and test one auditable automatic paper-decision record.
Generate deduplicated daily paper decisions in the scheduled pipeline.
Separate the Architecture page into a simple story, variable decoder, and technical detail.
Add a 3D architecture knowledge graph and owner-priority decision cards.

next_commits.title: Define one automatic paper-decision record
next_commits.why: Every run needs the same auditable schema before outcomes can be measured.
next_commits.done_when: The app records ticker, action, reason, horizon, model version, size, stop, target, constraint state, and timestamp.

next_commits.title: Generate daily paper decisions
next_commits.why: The system must make repeatable decisions without manual ticker selection.
next_commits.done_when: One pipeline or local command writes buy, hold, watch, reduce, avoid, and blocked decisions for the day.

next_commits.title: Simplify the architecture story
next_commits.why: A new user should understand the system before seeing every variable and pipeline detail.
next_commits.done_when: The page opens with a five-stage decision story and keeps variables and technical detail in separate views.

next_commits.title: Build the interactive model architecture map
next_commits.why: The owner needs to see how variables, models, rules, decisions, and outcomes connect without reading a long technical page.
next_commits.done_when: Architecture shows a rotatable 3D graph, node details, and honest implemented, partial, and planned states.

next_commits.title: Update paper outcomes
next_commits.why: Predictions become useful only when later results are attached to the original decision.
next_commits.done_when: Open decisions receive 1d, 5d, 20d, and 60d returns without future-data leakage.

next_commits.title: Build the paper performance page
next_commits.why: The owner needs one place to see whether the combined decision policy is helping.
next_commits.done_when: The app shows action counts, win rate, average return, drawdown, open decisions, and comparison with baselines.

next_commits.title: Backtest the same decision policy
next_commits.why: Historical testing should reuse production decision rules instead of inventing a second strategy.
next_commits.done_when: A walk-forward backtest includes sizing, holds, stops, targets, constraints, turnover, and benchmark comparisons.
